shortDescription: Dashboard home view route in its default state.
fullDescription: Renders the dashboard-home view in its default state on the root route, composing the reusable dashboard layout with a top toolbar, quick action sidebar, summary metric cards, a performance snapshot section, and a team highlights panel.

shortDescription: User profile overview view route in its default state.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a GitHub-style profile header, interactive profile tabs, identity sidebar, popular repositories grid, contribution heatmap, contribution settings select, and selectable year list.

shortDescription: Reusable dashboard home screen composition component.
fullDescription: Provides the dashboard-home presentational view with a serializable state prop, locally interactive search field and quick action selection, summary metrics, and reusable card-based dashboard sections that can be rendered by any route needing the same home dashboard layout.

shortDescription: Reusable user profile overview screen composition component.
fullDescription: Provides the user-profile-overview presentational view with a serializable state prop, selectable profile tabs, editable search field, contribution settings select, year selection controls, and reusable profile content sections for routes that need the same GitHub-style overview layout.
